verses.1: May the city be destroyed and ruined!
verses.2: She did not listen to the voice of God; she did not take up His message. She did not trust in her God at all. She did not even touch Him.
verses.3: Her breasts are pierced with holes; they cry out in pain. The vultures at dusk do not cause any harm in the morning.
verses.4: Their prophets are false prophets; their priests have profaned the holy places. They have corrupted the laws.
verses.5: YHWH is righteous; He does not act unjustly in the morning. In the morning, He gives judgment. He does not delay in giving justice. He does not know what is right or wrong.
verses.6: I recognized that those nations had destroyed their own faces. I destroyed their cities, leaving them without any survivors. Their cities were abandoned by anyone who lived there.
verses.7: I said, “But do not be afraid of me. Take this task upon yourself, and do not expect any payment for all that I’ve done for her. Now, their lies have been exposed, and they have been destroyed.”
verses.8: So wait for me, O LORD! Let me rise up today. For my judgment will bring together nations to condemn their kings. My wrath will be poured out upon them. All the land will be destroyed by my jealousy.
verses.9: For then, I turned my speech towards those nations, so that they might all call upon the name of Jehovah to serve Him as one.
verses.10: From there, it goes to the rivers of Kush. Ataray, daughter of Puzai, is my resting place.
verses.11: On that day, I will not be burdened by all your sins. For then, I will be freed from your presence, and no longer have to remain on the holy mountain.
verses.12: And I remained with you as a poor and needy person, but I was protected in the name of Jehovah.
verses.13: The rest of Israel will not do evil, nor will they speak lies. They will not have any hidden meanings in their words, as those who do evil and commit wrongdoing do. There will be no forgiveness for them.
verses.14: Rani, daughter of Zion, rejoiced over Israel. She was happy and glad with all her heart, in the city of Jerusalem.
verses.15: May the LORD remove your judgments from you, O king of Israel. May the LORD not let you suffer any more harm.
verses.16: On that day, it will be said to Jerusalem: “Do not be afraid of Zion; do not withdraw your hands.”
verses.17: Oh Jehovah, your God! In your presence, there is a mighty savior. He will bless you with joy and love. He will grant you prosperity.
verses.18: From various places, I gathered them from you. They carried shame upon themselves.
verses.19: I will carry out all your commands at that time. I will save those who are in distress and rejected. I will make them rise up again, and they will be restored to their rightful place throughout the entire land.
verses.20: At that time, I will bring you back, and at that time I will gather you together again. I will give you a place to live, and a place for you to worship in all the nations of the earth. When I restore your nation to its former glory, as Jehovah said.
